nodes.name: Model dropdown
nodes.description: Displays the current model and lets the user select the model used by subsequent chat requests.

nodes.name: Chat request
nodes.description: The next main chat, clarification, scenario comparison, or post-edit analysis request started by the user workflow.

nodes.name: Chat model catalog
nodes.description: The predefined model IDs, display labels, and complete model, provider, and reasoning configurations.

nodes.name: Selected model ID
nodes.description: The model selected for the next request in the current task-pane session.

nodes.name: Resolve selected model configuration
nodes.description: Resolves the selected model ID to one complete immutable request configuration.
nodes.algorithm: Look up selectedModelId in the chat model catalog and return that entry's complete model, provider, and reasoning configuration. Use the explicit model ID as the key; never use the display label as an identifier.

nodes.name: Assemble chat request
nodes.description: Builds a fresh request body using the current request inputs and the model configuration sampled when the request starts.
nodes.location: LLMManager.runMainQueryPrompt, LLMManager.runClarificationResponsePrompt, LLMManager.runScenarioComparisonPrompt, LLMManager.runUpdateAnalysisPrompt; llm-manager request builders.buildMainQueryRequestBody, llm-manager request builders.buildClarificationResponseRequestBody, llm-manager request builders.buildUpdateAnalysisRequestBody
nodes.algorithm: At each chat request boundary: sample the current model configuration once; create a fresh request body from the request inputs and that complete configuration; serialize the body without retaining a reference to mutable selection state. Do not merge settings over a previous model configuration.

nodes.name: OpenRouter Responses endpoint
nodes.description: Receives the serialized request body containing the model selection captured for that request.

relationships.data: Model option IDs and display labels, including the default option.
relationships.purpose: Populates the selector with the predefined choices and displays the configured default when the task pane opens.

relationships.data: The model ID chosen by the user.
relationships.purpose: Retains the latest selection for the next request without submitting a message or resetting the workflow.
Keeps the displayed option synchronized with session state through running, review, Clear, and Restore states.

relationships.data: The model ID current when a chat request starts.
relationships.purpose: Selects the configuration for the new request while leaving already submitted requests unchanged.

relationships.data: Immutable catalog entries keyed by model ID, each containing complete request settings.
relationships.purpose: Provides an entire configuration so settings absent from one model cannot leak from a previously selected model.

relationships.data: The prompt, conversation history, tools, response schema, and other existing request inputs.
relationships.purpose: Supplies the request-specific content that is combined with the selected model configuration.

relationships.data: The complete model, provider-routing, and reasoning configuration sampled for this request.
relationships.purpose: Makes the latest selection apply to this request while isolating its body from later selection changes.

relationships.data: A serialized Responses request body containing the captured model settings and existing chat request content.
relationships.purpose: Sends the request with the selected model while preserving the existing transport and response handling.
